notes.title: Update v0.0014 - Network Optimization and Bugfixes !
notes.content: [p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Network performance has been optimized.[/p][/*][*][p]General optimizations were made to improve FPS.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented the settings menu from appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that blocked character costumes from loading.[/p][/*][/list]

- Fixed an issue that blocked character costumes from loading.

notes.title: Update v0.0012 - Spectator Mode and Ban System
notes.content: [p][b]Spectator Mode & Ban System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Spectator Mode[/b] so that you can now watch the other players.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a [b]new Ban System[/b] that allows you to ban/unban other players.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Network Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lobby join errors now display clear error messages.[/p][/*][*][p]General network stability improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay & UI Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now hide player avatars in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement is now smoother.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual & Content Cleanup[/b][/p][list][*][p]All [b]AI-generated logos and Steam capsule artworks[/b] have been removed from both the game and Steam pages.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Map Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mountain Easy map became easier.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing and your feedback keeps making this game even better![/p]

tags.feature: Added Spectator Mode so that you can now watch the other players.
Introduced a new Ban System that allows you to ban/unban other players.

tags.bug: Lobby join errors now display clear error messages.

tags.feature: You can now hide player avatars in the game.

tags.bug: All AI-generated logos and Steam capsule artworks have been removed from both the game and Steam pages.

notes.title: Update v0.0011 - Localization, New Content & UI Improvements
notes.content: [h3] [b]Localization Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added support for [b]Polish, Czech, Russian, and Portuguese - Brazil[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing characters in [b]Korean and Chinese[/b] languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]language selection button[/b] in the [b]Settings menu[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Gameplay & UI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A message now appears in the [b]top-left corner[/b] when a player dies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]tutorial map[/b] to help new players.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an [b]extra map[/b] to [b]Demo[/b] version.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming![/p]

tags.feature: [*]Added support for [b]Polish, Czech, Russian, and Portuguese - Brazil[/b].

tags.bug: [*]Fixed missing characters in [b]Korean and Chinese[/b] languages.
